text_block_list.text:
One evening, I'm wandering the campus
grounds
in search of Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I spot her heading up the stairs to the
roof, a
grave expression on her face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume I raced against the
other day has
quit the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Apparently, after seeing my
performance, she felt
that she could
never compete.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
She is not the first to feel that way. I
have
watched several other Umamusume
leave the
academy under similar
circumstances.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
With every spirit I have inadvertently
broken, I
have sworn to myself anew...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I will do my utmost to make my racing a
guiding
light...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
A beacon to lead the way to a brighter
future for
all Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But I cannot deny that I sometimes have
doubts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I seek to reach the top by climbing the
mountain
of victory, for the good of all
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But am I truly doing that for their
benefit? Or
simply to satisfy my own
ego?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I have asked myself this question many
times, and
every time, I have concluded
that my path is just.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I believe that even the Umamusume I
hurt will
benefit from the future I hope
to build.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I have to believe it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Tell me, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Do you think my dream is worth
pursuing?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list:
A little late for second thoughts, don't you
think?

text_block_list.text:
Do you think my dream is worth
pursuing?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list:
A little late for second thoughts, don't you
think?

text_block_list.text: At least one of us is free of doubts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Perhaps I'm simply feeling jaded today.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: It's nice to see a different side of you.

text_block_list.text:
I take my eyes off you for an instant, and
there
you go, slipping ahead of me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Please, shake my hand once more and
promise
me...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Promise me you'll stay by my side as I
walk this
road...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: And keep me straight and true.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I grasp Симболи Рудольф's hand, squeeze
it firmly,
and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You're right. I was foolish not to see it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's up to me to prove that my path is
correct.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I've grown a little too used to leaning on
you, it
seems.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: I'm happy to be leaned on.

text_block_list.text: Haha, you're really too much sometimes.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Please, shake my hand once more and
promise
me...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Promise me you'll stay by my side as I
walk this
road...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And judge for yourself the leader I
become.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I grasp Симболи Рудольф's hand, squeeze
it firmly,
and...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: She smiles, just a little.
